name: Why is it important to address storm damage quickly?

mainEntity.name: Why is it important to address storm damage quickly?

acceptedAnswer.text: Addressing storm damage quickly is crucial to prevent secondary issues that can worsen the situation and increase repair costs. For example, water intrusion can lead to mold growth within 24-48 hours, compromising air quality and building materials. Unsecured openings can allow further weather damage or invite pests. Timely intervention safeguards your property's structural integrity and your health.
acceptedAnswer.description: Addressing storm damage quickly prevents secondary issues like mold growth, further weather damage, and increased repair costs.
